_readme: Hand fixes for individual block faces. Loaded by build/preprocess.js (loadCurbOverrides).
To add one: copy the face id from a tile segment id and drop the trailing _<n> (e.g. segment WEST_HOUSTON_STREET_BROADWAY_MERCER_STREET_N_3 -> face WEST_HOUSTON_STREET_BROADWAY_MERCER_STREET_N).

Fields: offsetM (metres from the base line toward the face's compass side; negative = away from it), base ('osm' = from the block's own OSM line, the default; 'outer-carriageway' = from the outer carriageway centerline, i.e. offsetM is added to the general rule's sibling shift), suppress (true drops the face).
Precedence: override > Option A > general carriageway rule > legacy per-street offset.
An id the build never produces is a HARD BUILD ERROR (typo / rename guard). Give every row a note and a verified date. Keep this file small.
After editing run: node scripts/test-width-offset-resurrection.js and node scripts/report-tile-changes.js.

overrides.note: DT35-7: OSM slice here is a stub chain 9.7 m north of the north carriageway centre (nearest CSCL row 10 m away, so the general rule declines). Curb = row centre + 0.88 x 6.7 m, i.e. 3.7 m back toward the road from the stub.
DT35-7: same stub chain; the south curb is the 34 ft TF row 25.1 m south of the stub + 0.88 x 5.18 m = 29.7 m.
